Excellent! All 44 tests pass. I've successfully added two line-modification functions to src/invoices.js:

**`addLine(invoice, { sku, qty })`** — adds a new line to a draft invoice or increases qty if that SKU already exists
- Validates qty (QTY_INVALID)
- Validates SKU exists (UNKNOWN_SKU)
- Returns NOT_DRAFT if invoice status isn't 'draft'
- Never mutates the original invoice

**`removeLine(invoice, sku)`** — removes a line from a draft invoice by SKU
- Returns LINE_NOT_FOUND if SKU isn't on the invoice
- Returns NO_LINES if it would remove the last line
- Returns NOT_DRAFT if invoice status isn't 'draft'
- Never mutates the original invoice

**Error codes added to errors.js:**
- LINE_NOT_FOUND
- NOT_DRAFT

**Tests added (14 new tests):**
- Adding new lines and increasing existing quantities
- Validation (qty, SKU)
- Draft status protection
- Non-mutation guarantees
- Multiple consecutive operations
- Combined add/remove workflows

All 44 tests pass. Ready for the next request!
